Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1144); Benjamin, an Israelite:--Benjamin.
BiblicalUsage: The name Benjamin appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Acts 13:21, Romans 11:1 and Philippians 3:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Benjamin is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
